unresolvedReferences.description: The Nanchang–Wuchang campaigns are undated here; bounded to 1361–1364 from the known Poyang campaign.
番遇 is read as Fanyu (番禺) county; the translation renders it as Fan Prefecture.
The southern campaign under Deng Yu is undated; bounded between Hongwu 4 (1371) and 13 (1380).
The second Fujian mission (居無何) is undated; bounded 1385–1389.
Wang Bi's Central Plains/Shaanxi campaign is undated in text; bounded 1368–1370 from the Yuan capital's fall.
Cao Zhen's four-point memorial (逾年) dated ~1389 by inference from Hongwu 21 (1388).
Cao Xing's execution (後數年) assigned to 1393 by the Lan Yu case.
Nobles' return of households after Li Xin's proposal is undated; bounded 1390–1393.
Xie Cheng's Duogan campaign under Mu Ying is undated (likely c. 1378).
